```python
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load data into a DataFrame
data = {
    "StichtagDat": ["2024-12-31", "2025-12-31", "2019-12-31", "2020-12-31", "2021-12-31"],
    "StichtagDatJahr": [2024, 2025, 2019, 2020, 2021],
    "KreisLang": ["Kreis 7", "Kreis 7", "Kreis 10", "Kreis 10", "Kreis 10"],
    "QuarLang": ["Hottingen", "Hottingen", "Höngg", "Höngg", "Höngg"],
    "Rasse1Text": ["Deutsche Dogge", "Deutsche Dogge", "Continental Bulldog", "Continental Bulldog", "Continental Bulldog"],
    "AlterVHundLang": ["4-Jährige", "5-Jährige", "0-Jährige", "1-Jährige", "2-Jährige"],
    "AnzHunde": [1, 1, 1, 1, 1]
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Set plot style
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a bar plot
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
bar_plot = sns.barplot(
    x="StichtagDatJahr", 
    y="AnzHunde", 
    hue="Rasse1Text", 
    data=df, 
    palette="muted"
)

# Add title and labels
bar_plot.set_title("Number of Dogs by Breed and Year")
bar_plot.set_xlabel("Year")
bar_plot.set_ylabel("Number of Dogs")

# Move the legend
bar_plot.legend(title="Breed", loc='upper left')

# Save the plot to a file
plt.savefig("output.png", bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
```
